author: sakura-ngt
body:
#### PR description:

This PR improves the HLT scouting DQM modules used in the NGT workflow, fixes several bugs, and adds the scouting jet DQM to the scouting-only sequence.

`ScoutingCollectionMonitor`:
- Bug fixes:
  - HF hadron and HF e/gamma PF candidate MEs (`pT`, `vertexIndex`) were swapped.
  - A missing electron best-track ValueMap made `analyze` return early and drop all other plots; now only the best-track plots are skipped.
  - Added guards for `ndof <= 0` and for events without primary vertices.
  - Corrected the HBHE subdetector selection (explicit HB/HE switch, warning otherwise).
  - Fixed the binning of the EB, EE and HCAL occupancy maps.
- Integer-valued quantities are now booked with one unit-width bin per integer.
- The multiplicity ranges and the rho binning are configurable (`multiplicityRanges`, `rhoBinning`), with Run 3 defaults, to allow rescaling for Phase-2.
- Harmonised axis titles and units, fixed typos, removed unused includes and per-event state.

`ScoutingTrackMonitor`:
- Reorganised the MEs into sub-folders (`Event`, `Tracks`, `TracksBS`, `TracksPV`, `Vertices`, `BeamSpot`).
- New MEs: event counts, track kinematics, fit quality and perigee parameters, IP w.r.t. the beam spot, vertex properties, PV-BS residuals, track-vertex association, and closure tests between the rebuilt `reco::Track` and the stored values.
- Bug fixes:
  - The module no longer returns early when there are no vertices or no beam spot.
  - Only valid vertices are used.
  - The dxy error now uses the projected vertex covariance.
  - Pulls are only filled when the error is positive.
  - The y-ranges of the IP error profiles are consistent with the 1D histograms.
- Removed the `boost` dependency, the commented-out code and the repeated fill blocks.

`DQMOffline`:
- `hltDqmOnlyScouting` now also runs the scouting Ak4 jet DQM.
- Added `onlineMetaDataDigisSrc` to `DCSFilterForJetMonitoring`.

Changes in the output: DQM MEs only, no change in event content. Several MEs are renamed, moved or rebinned (HF PF candidate MEs, occupancy maps, all `ScoutingTrackMonitor` MEs).

#### PR validation:

- `scram b code-checks` and `scram b code-format`
- `scram b runtests` for `DQM/HLTEvF` and `HLTriggerOffline/Scouting`.
- Ran the workflow in [HLTriggerOffline/Scouting/test](https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/blob/master/HLTriggerOffline/Scouting/test/test.sh)

#### If this PR is a backport please specify the original PR and why you need to backport that PR. If this PR will be backported please specify to which release cycle the backport is meant for:

Not a backport. Backports down to 16_0_X will follow.
